stages.learnerPrompt: What catastrophic failure physics occur when capacity limits or downstream dependencies degrade under peak load?

referenceMaterial.summary: Failure physics analysis: 50k Mut. → Row X-Lock → Spinlock Thrash → Deadlock Graph → 💥 DB Freeze.
failureModes: Cascading Failure: Every lease renewal increments etcd's revision counter . Historical revisions accumulate in the underlying BoltDB B-tree. The etcd database file expands to the 8 GB quota limit, locking Kubernetes into a read-only freeze.
Breakdown Chain: 50k Mut. → Row X-Lock → Spinlock Thrash → Deadlock Graph → 💥 DB Freeze
Shedding Failure: Without fast rejection at the boundary, queued dead work triggers multi-second GC pauses, CPU thrashing, and cascading 504 Gateway Timeouts.
